_comment: Authentic test datasets, published as GitHub Release assets on barricklab/CNery.
One release per dataset version, tagged testdata-<name>-v<N>, carrying a single .tar.gz.
Adding or revising a dataset touches only its own entry here -- no other dataset is
The sha256 -- not the tag -- is what makes a dataset immutable. If an asset is replaced
in place, the hash check fails loudly rather than silently changing what the tests run on.
Generate an entry with:  python tests/data/add_testdata.py <folder> --name <name>
Fetch during tests with: pytest -m authentic
